correctness.rationale: Independently rebuilt connectivity for every one of C(21,5)=20349 removed 5-subsets: 2520 facets and ordinary f=(21,210,1330,3024,2520). Pivot matching has 3220 pairs; verified acyclicity by a complete directed Hasse topological sort of all 7105 nonempty faces. Independently computed signed normal forms for all 650 critical four-cells relative to the 14 critical 3-cells: exactly thirteen columns e_i-e_13 are nonzero with 13 unit pivots, leaving one 3-cell and 637 4-cells. Since no positive cells below dimension 3 and attachments into a wedge of 3-spheres are classified by π3~Z, the primitive integer reduction gives the claimed integral homotopy type. Rebuilt explicit eight-term integral 3-cycle and cocycle, checked cocycle on all 2520 four-faces and unit evaluation; 42 signed dihedral permutations all act trivially on H3. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz counts produce Lred=(636 for id,6 at two order-three rotations,-1 other rotations,-8 at 21 reflections), hence H4 traces stated and invariant-rank mean (637+14-147)/42=12. Exhaustive proof is finite at k16; there is NO all-parameter inference.
